newsitem.title: TURKEY: FIRST IRAQI CEYHAN TANKER LOADING MIDNIGHT-TERMINAL.
newsitem.headline: FIRST IRAQI CEYHAN TANKER LOADING MIDNIGHT-TERMINAL.

text.p: The first tanker to lift Iraqi oil under the second term of the oil-for-food deal is berthing at the Ceyhan terminal port on Wednesday and will begin loading at midnight, a Ceyhan port official said.
"The Arcadia is now berthing and this will be completed by around 4 p.m. (1300 GMT)," the official said.
"The loading will begin sometime around midnight, around 24.00 (2100 GMT)," he told Reuters.
He said it would take the 299,986-DWT, Maltese-flagged Arcadia about 30 hours to be loaded with Iraqi Kirkuk crude.

The vessel is contracted by U.S. trader Bayoil to load 2.1 million barrels as the first scheduled lifting of Iraqi Kirkuk oil under the second term of the U.N.-monitored oil-for-food deal which expires on December 8.
Ceyhan officials said earlier that loadings might be delayed.
The Arcadia has been waiting off Ceyhan since Monday.
Iraq aims to sell about 1.5 million barrels per day until September 5, when the first 90-days of the second six-month oil-for-food deal ends.
